bugs.reproduction: Compare the authenticated shell, login, PWA manifest, native package and authorization copy.
bugs.expected: One approved product name and descriptor sourced from typed configuration.

bugs.reproduction: Open Students and attempt to review attendance, fees, results and governed documents for one student.
bugs.expected: A coherent, permission-bounded Student workspace with lazy sections.
bugs.actual: Users switched among disconnected module pages and no Student 360 destination existed.

bugs.reproduction: Open a Staff record and try to review assignments, attendance, leave, documents, account and governed payroll state.

bugs.regressionTest: tests/product-experience-1a.test.ts keeps Student and Staff 360 sections lazy and permission bounded

bugs.reproduction: Submit a Staff update, then interrupt the network before a response is received.
bugs.expected: Saving ends, the entered values remain, and a recovery action is explained.
bugs.actual: The request path had no catch/finally recovery and could remain in a saving state.
bugs.rootCause: The client request helper handled HTTP failures but not transport or response-parse failures.
bugs.regressionTest: tests/product-experience-1a.test.ts protects dirty forms and preserves recoverable submissions

bugs.reproduction: Inspect important status badges with colour perception removed or a screen reader.
bugs.expected: Status text, icon, semantic tone and accessible description.
bugs.actual: A small hard-coded subset used colour-only badge variants and unknown states collapsed to neutral.
bugs.rootCause: There was no shared semantic status vocabulary or icon mapping.

bugs.reproduction: Open a major data table below 720px and attempt an essential row task.

bugs.reproduction: Change a non-GET form and follow an internal or external navigation link.

bugs.reproduction: Run the exact-head Android debug build and packaged-app emulator UX job on the GitHub-hosted Linux runner.
bugs.expected: The gate resolves the installed Android SDK tools, boots the emulator, installs the APK and exercises portrait, landscape, tablet, lifecycle, deep-link and offline states.
bugs.actual: The Android APK compiled, but the emulator step stopped at adb: command not found before the app could launch.
bugs.rootCause: sdkmanager installed platform-tools under ANDROID_HOME, but that installation directory was not added to the step PATH and every device command relied on an unqualified adb executable.
bugs.regressionTest: Exact-head CI Android debug build and emulator UX gate using the verified ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb binary

bugs.reproduction: Run the exact-head Android emulator job when the emulator does not become reachable promptly.
bugs.expected: Every emulator and ADB operation has a bounded deadline and emits the emulator log when startup fails, so the mandatory gate reaches a diagnostic terminal result.
bugs.actual: The packaged-app exercise remained nonterminal for more than 18 minutes because adb wait-for-device and subsequent ADB operations had no command-level deadline.
bugs.rootCause: The workflow relied only on the broad 80-minute job timeout; a failed emulator launch or stuck ADB command could provide no bounded failure or useful startup diagnostics.
bugs.regressionTest: Exact-head Android emulator gate with a 240-second device deadline, 60-second ADB operation bounds and emulator-log output on startup failure

bugs.reproduction: Run the exact-head Android emulator gate on a hosted Linux runner where avdmanager and emulator resolve different default AVD storage locations.
bugs.expected: AVD creation and emulator launch share one explicit runner-local directory, and the gate proves the named AVD exists before launch.
bugs.actual: The system image and AVD creation commands completed, but the emulator reported Unknown AVD name px1a_phone and could not find its ini file under HOME/.android/avd.
bugs.rootCause: The workflow relied on implicit AVD directory discovery; the hosted runner tools did not agree on the default location after the SDK components were installed during the step.
bugs.regressionTest: Exact-head Android emulator gate with exported ANDROID_AVD_HOME, an ini-file assertion and emulator -list-avds proof before startup
